title: Codex adversarial review output
description: Strict shape passed to `codex exec --output-schema`. Kept flat and closed because OpenAI structured outputs require every property to be required and additionalProperties false.

verdict.description: blocker = at least one blocking defect; concerns = non-blocking defects only; clean = nothing material found.

summary.description: Two to four sentences. What was reviewed, the single most important conclusion, and whether the artefact can proceed.

findings.description: Ordered most severe first. Empty when the verdict is clean.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. DESIGN-001. Reused verbatim in later rounds so a finding can be tracked.

location.description: File path, section heading, task id, or component name. Never a whole-document reference.

claim.description: The defect itself, stated as a falsifiable assertion.

evidence.description: Concrete anchors: quoted lines, paths, identifiers. No raw logs.

recommendation.description: The smallest correction that resolves the claim.

blocking.description: True only if shipping with this defect would be wrong, not merely suboptimal.

residual_risks.description: Risks that are real but deliberately not raised as findings.

coverage_notes.description: What was NOT reviewed and why — missing context, truncated pack, unreadable file. Empty string if coverage was complete.
